profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Amperon
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer specializing in database systems, data infrastructure, and high-performance backend systems.
I have 20+ years of experience building production software, and in the last three startups I joined I was an early engineering hire, often the first backend/data/SRE engineer after the CTO. I’m comfortable turning ambiguous technical problems into robust systems: databases, pipelines, observability, APIs, performance work, incident response, and production architecture.
Recent work includes owning weather timeseries infrastructure, MySQL and ClickHouse operations at multi-terabyte scale, forecast-history/as-of data pipelines, and zero-downtime cross-cloud database migrations.
I’m strongest in roles where the company needs a senior/principal engineer who can own hard backend, database, and infrastructure problems end-to-end.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and implemented Amperon’s weather timeseries pipeline, integrating 4+ weather data vendors and supporting full forecast history, as-of queries, time travel, and model backtesting. 
-  Primary owner / DBA for 8+ managed MySQL instances with 6+ TB of data and 3+ self-managed ClickHouse clusters with 20+ TB of data. 
-  Designed and operated multi-tenant database architecture, backup policies, disaster recovery, credential rotation, query optimization, schema design, monitoring, and production debugging. 
- Designed and executed a zero-downtime cross-cloud database migration from GCP to Azure. 
- Led major re-architectures to improve performance, scalability, reliability, data accuracy, and system modularity. 
- Designed low-noise, high-signal observability with auto-resolving alerts and dashboards for fast diagnosis of production issues. 
- Built 30+ data integrations with third party APIs, including WSI/The Weather Company, DTN, Spire, NOAA NCEP NBM, Open-Meteo, ECMWF MARS/Dissemination, ERCOT, PJM, NYISO, ISONE, and MISO. 
- Trusted escalation point for ambiguous production issues, unfamiliar systems, performance incidents, and cross-system debugging. 
- Mentored engineers and handled knowledge transfer for complex backend, data, and infrastructure systems.

Backend engineering, data engineering, big data, security, devops.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Early backend/infrastructure engineer building security data collection and cloud backend systems.
 
- Developed the endpoint/data collection agent used to gather security telemetry from customer environments. 
- Built distributed backend services and APIs in Go. 
 Worked on cloud-native data ingestion and processing systems using Google Cloud services including BigQuery, Bigtable, and Pub/Sub. 
- Operated in a small engineering team where backend, infrastructure, reliability, and product execution overlapped heavily. 
 

Technologies: Golang, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud (BigQuery, BigTable, Pub/Sub, etc)
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Vision · Negotiation · Data Engineering · SQL DBA · Infrastructure Security · Coaching

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
First backend/data engineering hire at VividCortex, joining when the technical team was just the CTO and one frontend engineer. Helped build the database monitoring product from early prototype through production scale, owning core backend services, data collection agents, MySQL protocol decoding, and the in-house distributed timeseries database.

 
- Built core cloud product components, backend services, APIs, deployment systems, and customer-facing infrastructure. 
- Wrote early versions of the complex database monitoring agents, including packet sniffing, TCP stream reassembly, and MySQL protocol decoding. 
- Worked on standalone, self-updating agents deployed inside customer environments to collect and publish database performance telemetry. 
- Specialized in the in-house distributed timeseries database powering high-cardinality metric ingestion and sub-second analytical queries. 
- Built systems that ingested and queried metrics for thousands of customers, hundreds of hosts per customer, and millions of metrics at 1-second resolution. 
- Wore many hats, from SRE, production debugging, customer support escalation, and reliability work in addition to product engineering. 
 
Technologies: Go, MySQL, Linux, HAProxy, AWS, Ansible, Kafka.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Vision · Negotiation · Data Engineering · SQL DBA · Infrastructure Security · Coaching

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I worked at designing and implementing secure payment software components that integrate financial institutions, banks, credit card brands, POS networks and merchant systems; developing interfaces to enable communication between incompatible low-level variations of ISO8583 and other protocols and formats. 

Technologies: C, HSM

positions.title: Senior C++ Developer
positions.locationName: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
positions.description:
I worked as a subcontractor for Electronic Arts, writing C++ code for a AAA Xbox 360 and Playstation 3 sports title.

Technologies: C++

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on design and implementation of performance and stability critical APIs, daemons, batch processors, etc.
I designed and implemented  the in-house CDN for video streaming, authentication, transcoding, etc.
Also developed a pay-per-minute video-chat backend software.

Technologies: C++, Boost lib, PHP, Apache, Memcached, Nginx, Adobe Flash Media Server, ActionScript, javascript, ffmpeg

positions.title: Senior Developer / Game Engine Programmer
positions.description:
I worked as a contractor programming several browser based video games for Cartoon Network.
I later developed the company’s first attempt at a multiplatform downloadable game. 

I wrote the whole game engine from scratch (filesystem, 3D graphics, audio, 2D GUI widgets, input, space partitioning, collision detection, particles system, etc and then the actual game’s logic and the map editor).

Technologies: C++, OpenGL, SDL, Adobe Shockwave

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I developed several tools for migrating and validating databases

Technologies: Visual Basic 6, Visual Basic Script, MS-SQL Server 2000

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I developed a visual tool to create skins for the company’s desktop application.
Then I developed a web based video chat application with skinning support, emojis, user level access, etc.

Technologies: Visual Basic 6, C++, Flash Media Server 2
